parameters.jsCode: const arr=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);if(arr.length!==1||!arr[0].id||!arr[0].threadId)throw Error('Self-only Gmail API send failed to provide ID');return [{json:{status:'QA9_ACCEPTED_PENDING_HEADER_INSPECTION',id:arr[0].id,threadId:arr[0].threadId}}];

parameters.content:
## SELF-ONLY QA9

Tests sending from the existing Gmail credential's authorized **hyder@exampleabc.com** alias with explicit MIME **From** and exactly one **To: hakpilot@gmail.com**. NEVER send a prospect email with this workflow. It uses Google's Gmail API via n8n's Gmail OAuth credential and deactivates after one signed request. Post-test inspect actual RFC822 From/To; a success response alone does not prove the correct headers.
